# rikapio (রিকাপিও)

> rikapio (রিকাপিও) is a trusted Bangladeshi e-commerce platform offering authentic products at the best prices with Cash on Delivery, bKash, and Nagad payment options. Fast delivery across Bangladesh.

## About

rikapio (রিকাপিও) is a premium online shopping destination based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We sell authentic, high-quality products including fashion, accessories, gadgets, and lifestyle items. Our mission is to make quality products accessible to everyone in Bangladesh through a seamless, trustworthy online shopping experience.

## Key Facts

- **Brand Name**: rikapio (বাংলায়: রিকাপিও)
- **Also Known As**: rikapio shop, রিকাপিও শপ, rikapio bd, rikapio online, রিকাপিও অনলাইন, rikapio e-commerce, Rikapio ecommerce
- **Website**: https://rikapio.shop
- **Location**: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- **Phone**: +8801840469120
- **Email**: rikapioshop@gmail.com
- **Facebook**: https://facebook.com/rikapioshop
- **Currency**: BDT (৳)
- **Language**: Bengali (বাংলা) and English

## Services

- Online shopping with 100% authentic products
- Cash on Delivery (COD) across Bangladesh
- bKash and Nagad mobile payment support
- Inside Dhaka delivery: ৳60 (2-3 days)
- Outside Dhaka delivery: ৳120 (4-7 days)
- 7-day easy return policy
- AI-powered shopping assistant (rikapio AI)
- Order tracking system

## Categories

Fashion, Accessories, Gadgets, Lifestyle, and more — browse at https://rikapio.shop
